text:
Estimated before-meal portions:
- Lasagna: ~200 g, ~300 kcal
- Vegetables (carrots, corn, broccoli): ~150 g, ~90 kcal. The broccoli looks gone after the meal and most of the carrots and corn remain, so about 15% was eaten.
- Fruit bowl: ~100 g, ~50 kcal. Only a few apple pieces remain, so most was eaten.
- Chicken (a leg and sliced breast) with potatoes: the breast is ~120 g, the leg ~100 g with ~60 g edible, and there are 4 potatoes at ~200 g. Together about 380 g and 480 kcal.
- Noodles with meat: ~250 g, ~400 kcal.
- Dressing bottle: it looks about the same before and after, so I counted none.

Estimated leftovers:
- Lasagna: about 40% left.
- Chicken leg: left mostly intact, with the breast eaten.
- Potatoes: 1 of 4 left.
- Noodles: all eaten, with a little meat left.

Estimated amount eaten:
- Lasagna: 60% of 200 g, so 120 g and 180 kcal.
- Vegetables: 15% of 150 g, so about 20 g and 12 kcal.
- Fruit: 80 g and 40 kcal.
- Chicken breast: 120 g and 200 kcal. The leg is mostly left, so I counted a small amount of it.
- Potatoes: 3 of 4, so 150 g and 120 kcal.
- Noodles: 90% of 250 g, so 225 g and 360 kcal.

Totals are about 715 g and 912 kcal. Rounding down slightly for uncertainty gives roughly 900 kcal and 700 g.
